name: sentinel-investment-web
description: Sentinel Investment OS v20 decision, execution, research, portfolio and performance feedback system

scripts.predev: node scripts/apply-anti-churn-policy.mjs && node scripts/apply-meeting-resilience.mjs && node scripts/apply-shared-buffer.mjs
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/apply-anti-churn-policy.mjs && node scripts/apply-meeting-resilience.mjs && node scripts/apply-shared-buffer.mjs
scripts.validate:institutional: node scripts/validate-v7.mjs && node scripts/validate-v8.mjs && node scripts/validate-v9.mjs && node scripts/validate-v10.mjs && node scripts/validate-analyze-v12.mjs && node scripts/validate-holdings-v12.mjs && node scripts/validate-cio-v12.mjs && node scripts/validate-v13.mjs
scripts.quality: npm run validate:institutional && npm run audit:safety && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.pretest:committee: node scripts/apply-anti-churn-policy.mjs && node scripts/apply-meeting-resilience.mjs && node scripts/apply-shared-buffer.mjs
scripts.test:committee: tsc lib/team/committee.ts --outDir .test-build --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node scripts/test-committee.mjs .test-build && rm -rf .test-build
scripts.test:swing: tsc lib/team/swing.ts --outDir .test-build-swing --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node scripts/test-swing.mjs .test-build-swing && rm -rf .test-build-swing
scripts.test:conviction: tsc lib/team/conviction.ts --outDir .test-build-conv --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node scripts/test-conviction.mjs .test-build-conv && rm -rf .test-build-conv
scripts.test:technical-overlay: tsc lib/portfolioTechnicalOverlay.ts --outDir .test-build-overlay --module commonjs --target es2022 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node scripts/test-portfolio-technical-overlay.mjs .test-build-overlay && rm -rf .test-build-overlay
scripts.test:engines: npm run test:constitution && npm run test:committee && npm run test:swing && npm run test:conviction && npm run test:technical-overlay && npm run test:reconciliation
scripts.test:reconciliation: tsc lib/committeeReconciliation.ts --outDir .test-build-reconciliation --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck && node scripts/test-committee-reconciliation.mjs ./.test-build-reconciliation/committeeReconciliation.js && rm -rf .test-build-reconciliation
scripts.test:constitution: tsc lib/team/constitution.ts --outDir .test-build-const --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node scripts/test-constitution.mjs .test-build-const && rm -rf .test-build-const
